what: An estimate of the whole store from per-column measurements, not a store. See scripts/store_estimate.py for what is counted.

fields.field: stock locate and the references of E, C, X, D and U
A and F reference, U new reference
match number of E, C, P, Q and B
rest of S, R, H, Y, L, W, K, J, h, N and O

CR-1.what: Whole store ratio beats the pinned file's own .gz: at least 2.3415 on 12302019

CR-2.what: Whole store is smaller than Parquet, ArcticDB and QuestDB, each tuned per its docs
